question: What are the sub-techniques of attack technique 'T1561: Disk Wipe'?
answer_text:
Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
Found ATT&CK record T1561: Disk Wipe. T1561 (Disk Wipe): Adversaries may wipe or corrupt raw disk data on specific systems or in large numbers in a network to interrupt availability to system and network resources. With direct write access to a disk, adversaries may attempt to overwrite portions of disk data. Adversaries may opt to wipe arbitrary portions of disk data and/or wipe disk structures like the master boot record (MBR). A complete wipe of all disk sectors may be attempted.
